verdict.rationale: A LiteLLM maintainer confirmed that the proxy supports streaming the same way as the openai-python SDK. The docs say every response follows the OpenAI Chat Completions format regardless of provider, and the mock mode notes streaming is included. However, no first-party streaming documentation shows token-by-token streaming working across all providers through the gateway. missing for 10: first-party docs for streaming via the proxy, explicit confirmation of streaming across every provider, independent hands-on corroboration of token-level streaming.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream token-by-token responses through the gateway from any provider

citations.quote: LiteLLM maintainer confirmed proxy supports streaming and function-calling in the same way as the openai-python SDK
Every response follows the OpenAI Chat Completions format, regardless of provider.
